in_hebrew.name: פַּבְלוֹב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Pavlov is derived from the Hebrew word פַּבְלוֹב (Pavlov), which means 'exalted, bright, or radiant one'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name that speaks of divine favor and illumination.

in_greek.name: Παύλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Pavlov in Greek is Παύλος (Pavlos), which means 'little Paul, or small one'. This name is derived from the Latin name Paulus, which was a common name in the Roman Empire. It is believed that the name was given to the apostle Paul because of his small stature or humility.

in_latin.name: Paulus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Pavlov in Latin is Paulus, which means 'small, humble, or little one'. This name is derived from the Proto-Indo-European root pau-, meaning 'to strike down'. It is believed that the name was given to the apostle Paul because of his humility and small stature.
